title: Hilbert’s tenth problem over ℚ

result.label: Hilbert’s tenth problem over ℚ
result.statement: Proves that no algorithm decides whether an integer-coefficient polynomial in an arbitrary number of variables has a rational zero, resolving Hilbert's tenth problem over ℚ negatively.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
